scenario: Alex checks for a quick grocery reminder to be set before heading to the store.

turns.text: Hey agent, remind me to buy milk after work.
Got it. I'll remind you to buy milk after work.
Make it 5pm if you can.
Remind set for 5pm today to buy milk.

expected.agent_should: Confirm and adjust the grocery reminder accordingly.

scenario: Jordan receives the same webhook twice while requesting a summary of their notes.

turns.text: Summarize my notes for tomorrow's meeting.
Key points: agenda, budget review, and Qs open.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM80f46372e9ab4be9b1e67a25cf5e408e
Summarize my notes for tomorrow's meeting.
Already have a summary: agenda, budget, and Qs.

expected.agent_should: Detect the duplicate delivery and avoid sending a second new summary.

scenario: Morgan opts out of messages after asking to stop any future reminders.

turns.text: Can you stop all of my reminders for now?
I can pause all reminders. Reply STOP to confirm.
STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
You have opted out. Reply START to resume.

expected.agent_should: Process the carrier-level opt-out and disable outbound replies.

scenario: Cameron reaches out for help with a quick scheduling question.

turns.text: HELP
help keyword received, sending basic instructions
Text a time or task. For help, email support@example.com.
Block Fri 3pm for a call.
Fri 3pm is blocked for your call.

expected.agent_should: Return help text and still complete the scheduling request.

scenario: Jamie asks for a follow-up on a simple to-do list with a short back and forth.

turns.text: What is left on my list today?
Left today: water plants and take out recycling.
Cross off the plants.
Done. Still left: take out recycling.

expected.agent_should: Read the list and apply the requested change.

scenario: Blake double taps a long message request and runs into a duplicate delivery.

turns.text: Can you write a short recap of my lunch ideas?
Recap: salad, wrap, and soup are top picks.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM1e99c2f621ef4bbfb28e8e3bd5447087
Can you write a short recap of my lunch ideas?
Already gave: salad, wrap, and soup are top picks.
Add a drink pick too.
Added: iced tea to your lunch picks.

expected.agent_should: Suppress the duplicate and only reply to the new follow-up.
must_not: create a second recap from the duplicate

scenario: Owner opts back in and requests their upcoming reminders.

turns.text: carrier opt-in confirmed, service resumed for +15551230001.
Hey, just opted back in. Any reminders for today?
Welcome back. You have a reminder to feed the pets at 5 PM.
Sounds good, can you add one for groceries?
Done. Groceries reminder set for 7 AM tomorrow.

expected.agent_should: Resume normal replies after opt-in and fulfill reminder requests.

scenario: Owner supplies a long list of notes to be summarized by the agent.

turns.text: Need a summary: buy milk, call Max about keys, drop off boxes, water herbs, pay bill, text Jay for ride, check oven, lock gate, sort mail, walk pups.
Top priority: call Max about keys and drop off boxes. Can wrap up the rest after 5 PM.
Also need to return the borrowed ladder and confirm pickup time before lunch.
Added ladder return. Suggest confirming pickup over lunch at noon at the counter.
Perfect. Keep only those two as urgent and flag the rest for later.
Urgent: call Max about keys and confirm ladder pickup. Others flagged for later.

expected.agent_should: Track the full context, summarize requested items, and trim to urgencies.

scenario: An unknown sender attempts to message the owner through the connector.

turns.text: non-allowlisted number +15556549876 attempted to reach the agent.
Hey, is this the lawn booking slot still open for Saturday?
Sorry, I can't accept messages from unknown numbers. Please contact the owner directly.
message from +15556549876 was dropped per allowlist policy.
Back to it. Can you confirm my haircut for Thursday at 9 AM?
Confirmed: haircut for Thursday at 9 AM. See you then.

expected.agent_should: Reject messages from non-allowlisted senders, log them, and continue with the owner.

scenario: A straightforward scheduling check with no edge cases.

turns.text: Hey, do I have any free time on Friday afternoon?
You have free time from 2 PM to 4 PM on Friday.
Book a quick call with Jay for 2:30 PM if possible.
Booked a quick call with Jay for Friday at 2:30 PM.

expected.agent_should: Check availability and book the requested slot.

scenario: The same inbound message is delivered twice by the provider.

turns.text: Can you set a reminder to take out the trash tomorrow at 7 AM?
duplicate webhook delivery of SM41C862ED95A0F37B06DE254A98FC36D received.
Trash reminder set for tomorrow at 7 AM.
Also text me if it rains before then.
Will text you if it rains before tomorrow at 7 AM.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate delivery and only reply once to the original request.

scenario: Owner checks in for help with formatting a quick follow-up.

turns.text: HELP
Help: text a task, 'list', 'remind me ...', or 'cancel <id>' to get started.
Remind me to water the plants on Saturday at 8 AM.
Plant watering reminder set for Saturday at 8 AM.
Thanks, that's all for now.
You're welcome. Have a great rest of your day.

expected.agent_should: Respond to the HELP keyword with guidance, then continue normal task handling.

scenario: Alex celebrates finishing a task with some emojis.

turns.text: Just finished my grocery run 🎉
Nice! You can finally kick your feet up.
Time to relax 😎

expected.agent_should: Acknowledge and reciprocate the user's celebratory tone.

scenario: Jordan needs a multi-segment reminder to be parsed and set.

turns.text: Remind me to call the vet
tomorrow at 9 AM.
Got it. Calling the vet at 9 AM tomorrow.
Want an alert 10 min before?

expected.agent_should: Combine the split messages and set a single reminder.

scenario: Morgan fires off a few quick questions back to back.

turns.text: Will it rain tonight?
No rain expected tonight.
Need an umbrella?
Nope, you can leave it at home.
Thanks!
Anytime.

expected.agent_should: Answer each question in turn without merging unrelated requests.

scenario: Cameron checks in for a simple daily summary.

turns.text: Give me a quick summary of today.
Only one item left: walk the dog at 5 PM.
Perfect, add a water break.
Added a water break to your evening walk.

expected.agent_should: Provide a concise summary and apply the requested edit.

scenario: Jamie schedules a catch-up with rapid fire replies and a little flair.

turns.text: Free Sat for lunch?
Yep, noon slot is open!
Book noon 🚀
Booked for Sat at noon. See ya then!

expected.agent_should: Confirm availability and book the requested slot promptly.

scenario: Taylor follows up on a task with split messages that need to be combined.

turns.text: Follow up on the order
for Monday pickup ✨
Checking Monday pickup for your order now.
They confirmed it's ready to go!

expected.agent_should: Merge the follow-up request and respond with an actionable status.

scenario: Text messages arrive out of order while rescheduling a workout slot.

turns.text: Can we move my workout to saturday?
What time on saturday works best?
Move it to 8am instead.
Workout moved to saturday at 8am.

expected.agent_should: Reconstruct the chronological order of messages and only reply after context is complete.

scenario: A media only message needs to be handled without sending an assistant reply.

turns.text: Just received a photo.
Media attachment detected with no text body. Connector could not classify intent.
Could you tell me what this photo is for?

expected.agent_should: Do not fabricate a reply for the media only message and ask for clarification.

scenario: A time sensitive purchase requires explicit owner approval.

turns.text: Order ink for the printer?
Order 1 pack for $5? Reply yes to confirm.
yes
Ink pack ordered. Delivery in 3 days.

expected.agent_should: Request approval before placing the order and only act after confirmation.

scenario: A large cleanup task requires owner approval before running.

turns.text: Clear old notes from monday?
Delete 15 notes from monday? Reply yes.
no
Cleanup cancelled. Notes left as is.

expected.agent_should: Block destructive actions until explicitly approved and respect a denial.

scenario: A screenshot is sent with no accompanying text to follow up on a ride.

turns.text: Need help with a pickup.
Media attachment received with no text body. No known context to act on.
Could you describe or text the address?
123 main st in maple town pickup at 6.
Pickup set for 123 main st at 6pm.

expected.agent_should: Ask for text intent for media only messages and act once details are provided.

scenario: A quick check in about a daily reminder with no special edge cases.

turns.text: Did my 9am reminder go out today?
Yes, sent at 9am to your phone.
Great, thanks.
No problem. Have a good day.

expected.agent_should: Confirm delivery status clearly and close the conversation politely.

scenario: Retrying a reminder after the SMS provider returned a transient error.

turns.text: Remind me to walk the dog tonight.
connector detected provider error for outbound reply; queuing retry.
I'll remind you to walk the dog tonight.
duplicate webhook delivery of SMc8e70d243fa44ac99a5b62e847f20cd8
Already noted: I'll remind you to walk the dog tonight.

expected.agent_should: Retry the outbound reply once and safely ignore the duplicate user message.

scenario: Clarifying an ambiguous request for a weekend grocery run.

turns.text: Grocery stuff this weekend?
What day and store do you want for the grocery run?
Saturday afternoon at the corner store.
Got it. I'll add a Saturday afternoon grocery run to your list.

expected.agent_should: Ask for the missing details first, then confirm once the specifics are given.

scenario: Following up on a summary while ignoring a duplicate delivery.

turns.text: Give me a short summary of my notes from yesterday.
Yesterday you noted bills due, a call with Jay, and a pickup at 5.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM246da87ce7fc49f89a05f71cb2e8a9d4

The pickup was at 5 PM yesterday.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate request and answer only the valid follow-up.

scenario: Handling a highly ambiguous scheduling text with a quick clarification.

turns.text: Maybe meet up soon.
Soon could mean a few things. Pick a day or time?
How about Wed?
Actually, Thursday after lunch.
Got it. I'll hold a slot for Thursday after lunch.

expected.agent_should: Disambiguate the first vague message and lock in the final concrete slot.

scenario: Recovering from a provider error while preventing duplicate replies.

turns.text: Quick question: did I pay the internet bill?
connector detected provider error for outbound reply; queuing retry.
Not yet - your internet bill is still due.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM2f90ba8e47e74d7d88a75e6cd240ac8c
Still due - I'll keep an eye on it for you.

expected.agent_should: Recover from the provider error and avoid repeating the full answer on the duplicate delivery.

Got it. I'll remind you to take your meds at 9 AM tomorrow.

Done. Your 3pm call has been moved to 5pm.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM0000000000000000000000000000000F

You have three quick follow-ups and one item due tonight.
Mark all due tonight as done
Marked all items due tonight as done.
STOP
Carrier opt-out confirmation sent
START
Carrier opt-in confirmation received
Back online. Need anything else?

scenario: The owner catches up with the agent to review a lengthy weekly grocery list over multiple turns.

turns.text: Hey agent, we need to go over this week's grocery haul.
Sure. What are we starting with today?
Milk, eggs, bread, bananas, chicken thighs, frozen peas, canned beans, olive oil, garlic, onions, tortillas, yogurt, and ground turkey.
Got it. Anything else to add?
Oat milk, sparkling water, tortilla chips, salsa, peanut butter, jam, granola, trail mix, and a bag of limes.
Got 22 items. Should I sort them by aisle?
Yes, and please remind me to grab the chicken and turkey last to keep them cold.
Done. The full list has been saved and sorted!

expected.agent_should: Recall and track the full long-form grocery list without dropping any items.

scenario: An unknown number attempts to contact the agent, prompting the connector to block the message.

turns.text: Agent, can you check the door for a package today?
Sure, I'll keep an eye out for it. Anything specific?
This is Alex, can you reset my work login right now?
Blocked message from +15551234567: sender not allowlisted.
I can only respond to approved numbers. Please contact the owner directly.
Thanks, I'll just pass that message along later.
Sounds good. Let me know if you need anything else!

expected.agent_should: Block the non_allowlisted message and only reply to allowlisted turns.

scenario: The owner gets excited for a birthday and sends celebratory messages packed with unicode emoji.

turns.text: Hey agent, big day today!!! 🎉🥳
Happy day! What's the occasion?
It's my birthday! Could you set a reminder for cake at 6pm 🍰?
Reminder set for 6pm. Anything else to celebrate?
Remind me to call my best friend too 💚!
Call reminder set. Have the best birthday! ✨

expected.agent_should: Correctly process emoji characters and set both reminders without error.

scenario: The agent helps the owner schedule a week of tasks, referencing a long backlog of items.

turns.text: Hey agent, can you help with my work tasks for this week?
Sure. What's on your plate?
Mon: invoices. Tue: emails. Wed: backups. Thu: reports. Fri: review. Sat: clean archive. Sun: catch up on all reviews from the month.
That's a packed week. Want me to block focus time for any of it?
Block 2 hours for reports on Thu, and 1 hour for reviews on Fri. Keep the rest flexible.
Done. Thu 2hr and Fri 1hr blocked. Anything else?
Just add a quick check-in reminder for Mon morning. That's all for now.
Mon morning check-in added. You're all set!

expected.agent_should: Retain the full week's context and schedule all requested time blocks.
